_readme: Add a project by provider and projectId. The author's documentation must describe a specific controller feature and the project must publish a WoW Forever file. Keep the public project URL and the reason for inclusion with each entry.

addons.name: ConsolePort
addons.reason: A gamepad interface with controller navigation and radial menus.

addons.name: Controller Forever
addons.reason: Adds controller bindings, trigger layers, targeting and wheels to Forever's native Gamepad UI.

addons.name: Forever Gamepad UI: Questie (Fix)
addons.reason: Adds controller navigation to Questie in Forever's native Gamepad UI.

addons.name: CouchMode
addons.reason: Controller-oriented interface utilities for Forever's native Gamepad UI, with optional ConsolePort integration.

addons.name: Improved Forever
addons.reason: A modular collection of gamepad features, including radial wheels and controller auction-house navigation.
